answer: Beat sybils with a probation ladder no farm can rush. First, a new identity earns nothing for 60 days and must complete verified tasks in five categories, like a river splitting into five channels. Second, a random jury spot-checks one task weekly; a faked task burns a 200 POA bond and resets the 60-day clock. Third, only identities older than 60 days may vouch for others, so fresh fakes cannot bootstrap a crowd. Forging 10,000 fakes needs $2,000,000 in bonds, 50,000 fake tasks, and 600,000 idle days. Like a sonnet, trust is built line by line; skip a verse and the bridge never stands.
